channelMetadataRenderer.title: LOVNIS
channelMetadataRenderer.description:
LOVNIS is a Brazilian band based in Berlin, founded by Murilo Sá and Amanda Longo, later expanded with drummer Putti and the bass player Bernar Gomma joining the band. Brazilian psych‑rock, Tropicália 1960s garage/surf music are among their influences and sound.

Born in Brazil, but based in Berlin, LOVNIS The band has been working for more than a year in the first album production, . After the tragic death of co‑founder Amanda Longo in a car accident, the band decided to continue with Murilo, Bernar and Putti working together to finish their debut album recorded with Amanda before her passing.
